R4D-grouse-walk-0001.name: By Healy Creek
R4D-grouse-walk-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R4D-grouse-walk-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Healy Creek FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
13 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
14 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Route enters a Motor Vehicle for Hunting Closed Area: Lake Creek and Lardeau River. Closed October 20 to December 10. Synopsis map 2-33/23.

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.
bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 70 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 23, Hwy 31, Healy Creek FSR.
Park: 50.53907, -117.20545, pull off on Healy Creek FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 60 m to the start. Walk: the unnamed road stretch, 5.0 km one way. About 100 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-29, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4D-grouse-walk-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-29: about 449 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.55 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
